Use Security Keys. channelId The name of the channel to be recorded. uid The unique identifier of the recording server. If you set uid as 0, the SDK randomly assigns a uid and returns it in the onJoinChannelSuccess callback. If you set your own uid, it should be a 32-bit unsigned integer ranging from 1 to (232-1). config Detailed recording configuration. See RecordingConfig. Returns 0: Success. < 0: Failure.
